verdicts.note: It's a fun little game and I am keen to expand and improve, very impressed what was produced and how it plays.  Just needs a bit more balance and play test to make the goals a bit of a challenge and develop some strategies.

Cant think of a practical implementation right now, but in a post apocalyptic survival situation I may come to regret not paying more attention if i find myself in a dungeon with only an odd length stick and i need to map the labyrinth
i am not in the audience of people who was thinking about building a sundial.  Interesting as a though experiment there really isn't much to catch the user.
It has a therapeutic appeal watching the evolution and changing parameters to see what you can influence and it inspired let's play god
